resources.string: Skips TLS certificate verification when connecting. Only use with your own server that has no valid certificate — with a public network this allows man-in-the-middle attacks.
Blocks all traffic outside the tunnel, including IPv6, so nothing leaks to the open network if the VPN drops. Turn off if apps must keep working without VPN.

Starts the VPN with the last used settings after the phone reboots. Requires VPN permission granted (connect once manually). On some phones (Xiaomi/MIUI, Oppo, etc.) you must also allow "Autostart" in system app settings, and battery optimization should be disabled for reliable background work.

Buffers UDP packets that arrive out of order when traffic is split across several paths, and releases them in sequence. Helps video calls and games on multipath. CELLULAR BOND (buffer 1024 packets) suits two mobile links; FIBER LTE (2048) suits a fast link paired with LTE. List the UDP ports to reorder below.

Terminates TCP connections on the phone and relays them over a QUIC stream, so even a single download uses all paths at once (roughly the sum of both links instead of one). The server must have [Hybrid] Enabled=1. AUTO decides per connection (recommended), STREAM forces the TCP lane, RAW disables it.
Selected apps bypass the VPN entirely and use the network directly — useful for banking apps that block VPN connections. Takes effect on the next connect.
Checked apps will connect outside the tunnel.

On these Wi-Fi networks the VPN turns itself off: connecting to a listed network disconnects the tunnel, and auto-start after reboot is skipped. Useful when the home router already bonds links itself (e.g. OpenMPTCProuter to the same server). Reading the Wi-Fi name requires the location permission and location services enabled. NOT compatible with the system "Always-on VPN" / "Block connections without VPN" setting — turn that off and use the app\'s own auto-start and Kill Switch instead.
Allow location access (needed to read the Wi-Fi name)
Scan with the other phone\'s camera, copy the text and paste it into Import there. The code contains your auth key — don\'t show it around.
Paste the config JSON (from a QR scan or Copy).
The system may kill the VPN in the background or block auto-start after reboot. Exclude mqvpn from battery optimization; on some phones also enable "Autostart" for the app in system settings.
Trusted Wi-Fi detected, but system Always-on VPN blocks auto-disconnect. Turn off "Always-on VPN" for mqvpn in Settings → Network → VPN.
